title: Security fix for GHSA-hrxh-6v49-42gf applied in: yunikorn-k8shim 1.8.0-r4
description: A high-severity security vulnerability affects the yunikorn-k8shim package prior to version 1.8.0-r4. The issue has been resolved in version 1.8.0-r4. The vulnerability has a CVSS 4.0 base score of 8.8, indicating a network attack vector with no required privileges or user interaction, and high impact on integrity and availability.
